summary: Cohort commit lag produces interleaved model-variant responses during staged rollout
description:
Issue summary: During a staged canary rollout for NovaPay's dedicated tenant we observed sessions receiving interleaved token responses from two different model variants within the same request stream. Impact: Customer reports hallucination spikes and degraded conversation coherence for about ~3% of end-user requests during the rollout window. Environment: prod (dedicated pool) us-east-1, canary rollout configured as 5%->20% over 30m windows with model pinning enabled for tenant sessions.

Observed behavior: Instead of an all-or-nothing switch for cohorts pinned to the new variant, some sessions show token-level mix where earlier tokens were generated by the old model and later tokens by the new model (or vice versa). This occurs intermittently and appears correlated with cohort commit timing and edge cache entry updates.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Start a staged rollout for tenant 'novapay' from redwood-llama-13b-v1 -> redwood-rlhf-7b-v2-beta at 5% weight.
2) Ensure session affinity is enabled and that tenant uses long-poll streaming (websocket) for chat.
3) Kick off concurrent multi-turn sessions (10+ parallel sessions) that send requests spanning the commit window (e.g., start before cohort commit completes and continue during commit).
4) Observe responses and aggregation traces for token provenance across each stream; compare model_version metadata in tracing and edge headers.
logs: 2026-03-14T09:21:03.112Z TRACE cohort-controller: commit_attempt tenant=novapay cohort=cohort-7 commit_id=cc-9983 status=started trace=tx-7f2a
2026-03-14T09:21:03.456Z WARN edge-proxy: routing-cache-miss tenant=novapay key=cohort-7 old_pin=llama-13b new_pin=rlhf-7b-v2-beta trace=tx-7f2a
2026-03-14T09:21:03.789Z INFO serving-runtime: session_attach session_id=sess-44a token_index=1 model=redwood-llama-13b-v1 trace=tx-7f2a
2026-03-14T09:21:04.012Z INFO serving-runtime: session_attach session_id=sess-44a token_index=5 model=redwood-rlhf-7b-v2-beta trace=tx-7f2a
2026-03-14T09:21:04.250Z ERROR edge-proxy: response-mismatch tenant=novapay request_id=req-51123 detail=interleaved-variant-responses user-visible=true
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: cohort-controller committed new variant metadata in control plane, but edge routing cache and connection-level session binding were updated out-of-order causing some active streams to be serviced by both old and new backends.
Trace correlation shows the same trace ID (tx-7f2a) spanned requests hitting two different model backends within a 900ms window.
Edge cache TTLs are short (2s) but commit propagation and the proxy's in-flight connection mapping are not strongly synchronized — a race between commit ack and connection rebind was observed.
We cannot reproduce this in staging with the same client concurrency until we artificially add a small delay in cohort commit acknowledgement to mimic production timing.

Potential root causes: (A) control-plane commit returns success before all edge nodes have applied routing snapshot, (B) session-token affinity mapping uses mixed keys (cookie + header) and sometimes falls back to control-plane lookup mid-stream, (C) serving-runtime accepts rebinds without completing existing response streaming handshake.
comments: Support (2026-03-14 09:45) - Aisha Patel: Customer reported users seeing incoherent replies mid-conversation after we initiated the canary. They provided 6 request IDs and session IDs. Asked SRE to prioritize because customer is enterprise/dedicated.

SRE (2026-03-14 10:02) - Marcus Nguyen: Correlated logs for req-51123 show token provenance flip. Opening INT-1412 to track an internal follow-up with cohort-controller authors. Temporarily paused rollout to 0% as mitigation for affected tenant.

Customer (NovaPay) (2026-03-14 10:11) - Sarah Thompson: Confirmed pause reduced incidents but asks for root cause and a permanent guard to prevent partial-stream mixing. Provided sample transcripts attached to support email.

Engineering (2026-03-14 11:05) - Linh Tran: Reproduced locally by adding 150-300ms delay on commit propagation and noted race between edge ack and session rebind. Proposing a 2-phase commit: wait for edge-ack before control-plane returns success to prevent commit-lag exposure.

SRE (2026-03-14 12:20) - Marcus Nguyen: Applied temporary mitigation for NovaPay: forced TTL bump and soft-drain for active sessions to complete on old variant before allowing new cohort binding. Monitoring for reappearance.
temporary_mitigation: Paused canary weight for tenant 'novapay' and applied soft-drain policy: allow existing streaming sessions to finish on pinned variant, force new connections to evaluate routing snapshot; bumped edge routing-cache TTL to 5s and issued manual snapshot push to edge proxies.
next_steps: 1) Implement edge-ack handshake in cohort-controller so commit completes only after at least 95% of edge proxies confirm snapshot apply. 2) Add a session-rebind guard in serving-runtime to prevent mid-stream model-switch. 3) Backfill e2e test in reconciler repo that simulates in-flight streaming during commit. 4) Post-mortem and follow-up action items to be tracked in INT-1412 and GH PR 872.
resolution: In Progress - temporary mitigations applied, engineering change planned. Will update once patch merged and rolled out to prod.
